description: Design system, interaction model, and UI layout instructions for building a world-class Ludo game interface.

typography.score_numbers: Monospace / Tabular numbers for non-jittering animations

board_geometry_and_layout.home_bases: Rounded-corner squares with subtle drop shadows and inner glow when active.
board_geometry_and_layout.path_cells: Elevated tile appearance with soft inner inset shadows.
board_geometry_and_layout.safe_zones: Distinct star icons with shimmering shader effects.

token_design_and_states.token_style: Glossy 3D-effect tokens with drop shadow casting onto the board path.

states.idle: Standard token opacity and resting elevation.
states.selectable: Continuous subtle pulsing scale (1.0 to 1.15) with an outer radial glow ring.
states.moving: Parabolic arc jump animation along the path path with micro-squash on landing.
states.stacked: Subtle offset stacking with dynamic count badge on top.

dice_mechanics_and_hud.dice_view: Interactive 3D rotating cube with realistic physics momentum.

hud_layout.player_cards: Four corner cards showing avatar, timer ring, current status, and captured token count.
hud_layout.active_turn_indicator: Smooth gradient border pulsing around the current player's avatar card.
hud_layout.turn_timer: Circular shrinking progress ring around the active player's profile.

juice_and_microinteractions.dice_roll: Haptic feedback, sound effect, and screen shake on rolling a 6.
juice_and_microinteractions.token_capture: Impact ripple effect across the tile, particle explosion in player's color, and token fast-rewind animation.
juice_and_microinteractions.home_entry: Confetti bursts, victory chime, and glowing path highlight.

implementation_guidelines: 1. Never let tokens overlap completely; use dynamic grid offsets when multiple tokens land on a single tile.
2. Ensure all turn transitions happen under 300ms to maintain fast-paced gameplay.
3. Keep UI elements outside the board (HUD, chat, settings) translucent so the board remains the focal point.
4. Support 60fps/120fps animations for all token movement paths.
